_about: Curated Infosys-fit assessments for common social value initiative types. The AI tags each proposal with the closest type; the rating and reason shown to the bid team come from here, not from the AI. Draft judgements for Infosys to confirm. 'terms' are words that show the type in past responses.

types.name: Technology apprenticeships
types.reason: Technology apprenticeships fit Infosys delivery teams, and apprentices can work on the contract itself.

types.name: Recruiting people who face barriers to work (NEET, care leavers, long-term unemployed, disabled people)
types.reason: Infosys can create the roles; it needs a referral partner to reach the cohort.

types.name: Accredited upskilling and reskilling of the workforce
types.reason: Infosys already runs accredited learning for its workforce at scale.

types.name: Employability support: mentoring, CV and interview help, work placements
types.reason: Staff can mentor and run CV and interview sessions; a job centre or charity brings the participants.

types.name: STEM and digital careers activity with schools and colleges
types.reason: STEM and digital careers sessions are a natural offer for a technology employer.

types.name: Local, SME and VCSE supply-chain spend
types.reason: IT services are delivered mostly by Infosys staff, so local supply-chain spend is usually small. Commit only what procurement can evidence.

types.name: Pro-bono expert support for charities and small businesses
types.reason: Digital, data and cyber expertise is exactly what small charities and SMEs lack.

types.name: Staff volunteering in the local community
types.reason: Depends on enough contract staff being based near the community.

types.name: Digital inclusion: devices, connectivity and digital skills for residents
types.reason: Devices, connectivity and digital skills are close to Infosys's core work.

types.name: Cutting the carbon footprint of the service (cloud, data centres, code)
types.reason: Infosys can measure and cut the footprint of the service it runs (cloud, data centres, code).

types.name: Green space, biodiversity and tree planting
types.reason: Outside Infosys's core work; an environmental partner would lead and Infosys would fund and volunteer.

types.name: Reuse and refurbishment of IT equipment, e-waste reduction
types.reason: Infosys handles large volumes of IT equipment that can be refurbished and reused.

types.name: Digital skills academy on Infosys Springboard
types.reason: Infosys Springboard is a free digital learning platform Infosys already operates.

types.name: Cyber security clinics for small suppliers and charities
types.reason: Cyber security is a core Infosys service line.

types.name: Modern slavery checks in the contract supply chain
types.reason: Infosys publishes a modern slavery statement and audits suppliers; the contract-specific part is the supplier checks.

types.name: Health and wellbeing programme for the contract workforce
types.reason: Builds on wellbeing support Infosys gives its own staff, applied to the contract workforce.

types.name: Fair pay and secure contracts on the contract
types.reason: A pay and contract commitment for the people working on the contract.

types.name: Co-design with service users and community groups
types.reason: Design workshops with users are part of how Infosys delivers digital services.

types.name: Domestic abuse awareness for staff and suppliers
types.reason: Needs a specialist charity to design and deliver the content.
